author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
So we sit back to back
unable to see the clock
of time
to unstable to hit
rewind

For

I just need to see
the need for me
to exist in your
eyes

Moving forward into locked doors
columns stuck in polite solute
churning in unasked chores
stuck in a chat set to mute

chorus

My watch says its time to listen
so let me tell you this
No More
Its time I take back my story
Claim my own Glamor and
Glory

chorus
